newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends lower in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends lower in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.06 lower at 41.47 to the dollar in the kerb market on Thursday amid higher demand for the U.S. currency before Friday's religious holiday, dealers said.
The rupee is likely to open stable on Saturday, one dealer said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rupee rate, last changed on July 11, was 40.5200/40.7226 against the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 2.25 percent compared to the opening at 2.30 percent.
